definitions.explanation: A polite way to refer to someone else's home. The prefix ご adds respect. Used in business, customer service, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: ご{自宅|じたく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will deliver it to your home.

examples.japanese: ご{自宅|じたく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you tell me your home address?

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご{自宅|じたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{受|う}け{取|と}り→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ございませ→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧ん。
examples.english: The product will be delivered directly to your home, so there is no need to pick it up at the store.

notes:
The honorific prefix ご attached to ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧ (one's own home). This is a standard polite form used to refer to someone else's home in formal and business contexts. It is never used to refer to one's own home — that would be ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧ without the ご prefix.

This word is extremely common in customer service, delivery services, medical offices, and formal correspondence.

USAGE:
- Use ご{自宅|じたく} when referring to someone else's home (respectful)
- Use ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧ when referring to your own home (humble/neutral)
- The pattern parallels other ご-prefix honorifics: ご⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧, ご⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧, ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{自宅|じたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to deliver to someone's home
- ご{自宅|じたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{伺|うかが}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to visit someone's home (humble)
- ご{自宅|じたく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話番号|でんわばんごう}→電話番号：10159_denwabangou⟧: your home phone number
- ご{自宅|じたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: home care (medical)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧: one's home (neutral/plain)
- ⟦お{宅|たく}→お宅：01569_otaku⟧: your home (polite, also used for "your household")
- ご⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: your address (honorific)
